# no-card

> Check one repo against the README canon.

## Problem
Without this repo, the canon is prose and not a gate.

## Install
    pip install no-card

## Usage
Run the tool against a repo directory and read the row it prints.

## Contracts
- input: a repo directory
- output: one row per repo

## Family
Consumed by every repo in the family.

Language: loomground — guide https://github.com/flxk1/loomground/blob/main/llms.txt (the .lg language an agent reads, emits, validates); catalogue https://github.com/flxk1/loomground/blob/main/CATALOGUE.json
